**Authorization Bypass**

**Reachability:** External  
**Exploitability:** Trivial  
**CWE:** [CWE-863](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/863.html) — Incorrect Authorization

**Preserve password protection before rendering stored content.**

For a password-protected issue, WordPress supplies the password form to `the_content`. This filter replaces that form with `renderIssue($post)`, which reads the stored newsletter directly. An anonymous visitor can therefore read the newsletter without its password. The `isIssue()` and `is_admin()` checks do not enforce password protection. ([developer.wordpress.org](https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/functions/get_the_content/?utm_source=openai))

Return `$content` when `post_password_required($post)` is true. Add a regression check for a visitor without the password cookie.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-    if (!isIssue($post) || is_admin()) {
+    if (!isIssue($post) || is_admin() || post_password_required($post)) {
         return $content;
     }
```
</details>

**Compose content before WordPress runs shortcode processing.**

At priority `20`, this filter discards the output of `do_shortcode`, which runs at priority `11`. It then renders the stored blocks again. A Shortcode block inside any accepted section will display its literal shortcode instead of its output. The Shortcode block renderer itself only applies `wpautop`; it does not execute the shortcode. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-develop/6.9/src/wp-includes/default-filters.php))

Move composition before the standard block and shortcode filters, while preserving the password and email guards. Avoid applying the entire `the_content` filter recursively.

_🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🟠 Major_ | _🏗️ Heavy lift_

**Reject invalid email layouts instead of passing them through silently.**

After an issue has been marked, an author can add non-block text in the code editor. `sections()` rejects that content, but this branch returns it without a warning. The public Newspack renderer subsequently removes blocks whose `blockName` is `null`, so that text disappears from the email. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Automattic/newspack-newsletters/trunk/includes/class-newspack-newsletters-renderer.php))

Surface a validation error and prevent generation of a sendable email when the section contract fails. Do not use unchanged source content as a safe email fallback.

As per path instructions in `AGENTS.md`, “Unsupported or duplicate top-level content must fail visibly; never silently discard newsletter copy.”

_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Remove only warnings created by the overflow checker.**

When an issue has an invalid section layout, `renderIssue()` in `omni-platform-newsletter.php`, Lines 69–88, returns a `.opn-layout-warning` with the original content. On `load`, this line removes that warning. The next line then returns on screen media, leaving no visible explanation of the invalid layout.

Give overflow warnings a separate class or data attribute. Remove only those warnings, and preserve the renderer's contract warning.

Based on learnings, unsupported or duplicate top-level content must fail visibly.
